opportunities.title: Two Chains, One Week: MANTRA and MAYAChain Both Halted While Everyone Was Watching the Candles
opportunities.why_now: MANTRA froze its entire network just hours after MAYAChain halted from a $1.7M exploit, both landing in the middle of a euphoric BTC rally that had everyone looking the other way.
opportunities.angle: Comparative incident post-mortem: what 'halt the chain' actually means for holders, why it keeps happening on newer L1s/appchains, and the checklist for judging chain-halt risk before you bridge or stake — publish while both stories are still developing.

opportunities.title: 885,000 Phone Numbers Just Got Added to a Crypto Phishing Kit — Here's What That List Is Actually For
opportunities.why_now: A cybersecurity firm just disclosed a phishing campaign built around a database of 885K phone numbers, a scale large enough to matter to almost any reader with a SIM.
opportunities.angle: Explainer/threat-intel breakdown: how SMS-based phishing lists get built and monetized, what a targeted smishing message looks like in the wild, and the 3 settings (SIM lock, 2FA app vs SMS, carrier PIN) readers should check today.

opportunities.title: Fake 'AML Checker' Tools Are the New Approve-and-Drain Scam — Don't Paste Your Wallet Into Anything
opportunities.why_now: A fresh wave of fake AML/compliance checker sites is tricking users into wallet-draining approvals right as retail re-enters the market chasing the BTC breakout.
opportunities.angle: Threat breakdown + screenshot-style walkthrough of the scam flow, framed as 'the next generation of the fake-checker scam' with a hard rule: legitimate AML tools never ask for a signature.

opportunities.title: Coldcard Just Admitted Its Old Seed Generation Wasn't Good Enough — Here's What Changed and Who Should Care
opportunities.why_now: Coldcard shipped a firmware update specifically strengthening seed phrase generation, a rare public admission from a hardware wallet vendor that's worth unpacking while it's fresh.
opportunities.angle: Security-nerd deep dive: what was weak about the old entropy/generation process, why this matters even if you already have a wallet, and a clear yes/no on whether existing seeds need to be rotated.

opportunities.title: Everyone's Bragging About Short Squeezes — Nobody's Asking Why Two Protocols Halted the Same Week BTC Hit $80K
opportunities.why_now: CoinDesk/The Block are running wall-to-wall euphoria coverage (BTC $80K, $800M ETF inflows, $3B in shorts liquidated) at the exact moment MANTRA and MAYAChain both broke, a split-screen the market isn't talking about.
